definitions.gloss: deep emotion, being deeply moved, strong impression
definitions.explanation: A powerful emotional response, typically positive, such as being moved or inspired.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優|やさ}しさ→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感激|かんげき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was deeply moved by his kindness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{感激|かんげき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was deeply moved when I first saw Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{お客様|おきゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感激|かんげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: We received an emotional letter from a customer.

notes:
{感激|かんげき} describes being profoundly moved or touched emotionally.

Common patterns:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感激|かんげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be moved by ~)
- {感激|かんげき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (tears of emotion)
- {感激|かんげき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ (to cry from being moved)

Related terms:
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧ (being moved - similar but slightly less intense)
- ⟦{感心|かんしん}→感心：02559_kanshin⟧ (admiration, being impressed)
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}→興奮：02751_koufun⟧ (excitement)

The word combines {感|かん} (feeling) + {激|げき} (intense), suggesting intense emotion.
